title: Release Calendar Gap Watch
dataSources: Release events (`music:distribution`), Bandcamp activity (`music:bandcamp`), project exports (`music:project`), streaming analytics (`music:streaming`), metadata tasks (`music:ops`).
app: Music-making and creator telemetry — DistroKid release exports, Bandcamp sales activity, Cockos Reaper project stats, and Spotify for Artists analytics — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=music:ops release_name=* planned_release_epoch=* release_state=*
| eval days_left=round((planned_release_epoch-now())/86400,1)
| where release_state!="released"
| table release_name release_state days_left
| sort days_left
description: Lists open scheduled releases with time remaining for release calendar coverage.
value: Time-left monitoring helps prevent quiet deadline misses across the operational details that support release calendar coverage.
implementation: Store an expiry timestamp on `music:ops` events and filter for open or unfinished scheduled releases.
visualization: Table of open scheduled releases sorted by time remaining.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds which scheduled releases are about to run out of time so you can deal with them before release calendar coverage slips.
